description: This file defines a public enum 'ShareToAgentSettings' that manages persistent storage and retrieval of a default instruction string for sharing to an agent, using UserDefaults with a specific suite name.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves the default instruction string from UserDefaults, returning a fallback message if none is set or the stored string is empty.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Stores or removes the default instruction string in UserDefaults, trimming whitespace and handling empty input.
